messages: Ava (Design): quick design thread 165D vectors preview: when the table width shrinks the legend and action buttons wrap and hide the export button. thinking: put legend inside a sticky header and keep export/buttons grouped on the right. Zach (Eng): sticky header seems simplest. cheaper than a separate panel. keyboard order might change though; we should verify tab flow. Carmen (A11y): sticky is fine if legend items are focusable and have accessible names. at the moment the swatches are purely decorative with no aria-label. contrast is also an issue. Ava (Design): update: show text labels next to color swatches + optional shape markers (dot/square/triangle) for non-color cues. include a high-contrast toggle in header. Jon (PM): product note 61D keep export and bulk actions together so people can export the preview they're working with. splitting them caused support noise before. Zach (Eng): layout plan: left = legend toggle, center = density selector (compact/comfortable), right = export + bulk actions. will wire analytics event on density toggle. Liam (ML): rerank score currently shows a float like "0.83" with no context. can we append "(0-1)" or have an info link? non-ML PMs ask what the range is. Ava (Design): copy proposal: show shorthand "0.83" and a subtle help icon. tooltip text: "Rerank score (0-1): higher means more relevant to the query." Carmen: accessibility? Carmen (A11y): tooltip-only is insufficient. prefer an sr-only explanatory node referenced via aria-describedby on the score cell. example: `Rerank score from 0 to 1; higher is more relevant` and each cell `aria-describedby="score-desc"`. Zach (Eng): will add sr-only node. question: should we use a live region when scores update? could spam assistive tech. Carmen (A11y): avoid `role="status"` for every update. if row-level changes are significant, publish a polite live region summary like "Row 4 updated: score increased to 0.85". otherwise don't announce each token. Ava (Design): export modal text change: from "Download vectors" -> "Export vectors (CSV)" with subtext: "Includes id, truncated vector dims, rerank_score". Jon: we should warn when export > 10k rows. Jon (PM): yes — warn and recommend sampling. support saw timeouts for very large exports. Liam (ML): sampling options: First N, Random (default 1000), Stratified by score bucket. include a short blurb about representativeness when stratified is selected. Zach (Eng): performance: rendering more than ~300 rows kills the DOM. we'll cap preview to 100 rows and show a non-blocking banner: "Previewing 100 of 12,457 vectors D export will include all unless sampled." Ava (Design): banner copy: "Previewing 100 of 12,457 vectors. Export all or choose a sample." banner should be role=note, keyboard-focusable, and dismissible. Carmen? Carmen (A11y): yes. close button needs `aria-label="Dismiss preview notice"`. ensure focus returns logically after dismiss. don't trap focus inside the banner. Zach (Eng): accessibility nit: legend cannot be color-only. will add text + shape markers. also ensure swatch contrast meets AA or provide an explicit high-contrast skin. Ava (Design): microcopy for vector dims: show "[768 dims]" instead of raw arrays; on hover/focus expose full info. Carmen (A11y): hover-only is inaccessible. the same content must be available via keyboard focus with aria-describedby. Liam (ML): metric note: show rerank distribution histogram as an optional column to help users understand score spread. would be compact sparkline + alt text. Ava (Design): nice idea. show a tiny sparkline cell and an accessible label like "score distribution: lowDhigh". Jon (PM): analytics request: send events for export type, sample method, and density toggle to understand defaults. Zach (Eng): will emit events. also opening a PR tonight. ui-bot: deploy preview at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/batch-vectors-header (branch: design/batch-vectors-header) Ava (Design): I'll do a keyboard pass and update mocks. Carmen can you test with VoiceOver/NVDA when PR lands? Carmen (A11y): will check. blocking only if aria-describedby/live region patterns are missing. Zach (Eng): thanks all D PR linked in #eng once open. :thumbsup:
